name: ^context\.executor\.(suspend|resume)$

name: apps/gateway/src/agent.ts#followExecution
reason: Its behaviour is driven by a NATS async iterator racing a poll loop, whose contents and interleaving are not call inputs, so no twin can exist; replay checks every field of the execution it is handed.

name: apps/core/src/harness/sandbox/utils.ts#queueMirrorWrite
